thread:
ae_ravi: Quick sync. OmniRetail wants a dedicated POC pool — priority start next Monday (2026-04-06). Asking for 2x H100 (80GB) in us-east4, tenant isolation, with VPC peering. Can infra confirm lead time? :calendar:
se_ash: Also they need a temporary hosted API key for baseline runs while pool is provisioned. Scope it to read/write inference, 50 qps cap, logging on.
infra_jordan: H100s in us-east4 currently subject to allocation windows. Typical lead time ~4-6 business days. We can offer 1xH100 + 1xA100 mixed as a faster fallback. Need org id, AWS account id, CIDR for peering, KMS ARN if they require CMK, and allowed management IPs.
cto_emily: Org: org-omni-5543. AWS acct: 123456789012. CIDR: 10.12.0.0/16. KMS: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh. Enable rotation. Office IPs: 203.0.113.24/29. Netops contact: netops@omni.com (cc'ing).
se_maya: I'll prepare a scoped hosted key and the eval harness. Suggest canary test plan: 500 short prompts (200 tokens) at 10 concurrency, then ramp to 40 qps. Will validate P95 latency and KV cache warm-up.
infra_jordan: Noted. Management console access will be limited to 54.213.45.0/24 + the office range you provided. Billing will start when pool reaches "ready" state. We need a business justification + owner for the ticket.
ae_ravi: Business owner = @cto_emily. Justification: POC to validate latency and cost for production rollout; customer budget ~20k/mo for POC.
prov_bot: Created ticket PROV-4857 for OmniRetail dedicated pool. Initial state: pending-alloc. SLA target: 5 business days. Owner: @infra_jordan.
infra_jordan: I'll open allocation request and start network template for peering. Example Terraform snippet (for netops):
```
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "omni" {
  customer_aws_account_id = "123456789012"
  customer_cidr_block = "10.12.0.0/16"
  redwood_region = "us-east4"
  allow_management_console = true
}
```
netops_omni: Confirmed we'll accept the peering request and apply routes. We'll open a change window Thurs 03:00-04:00 UTC. point-of-contact: netops@omni.com.
infra_jordan: If H100 allocation delays, we'll provision mixed-sku and notify. ETA currently estimated 4 business days. Will post updates and logs to PROV-4857.
se_ash: Thanks — @se_maya once you have the hosted key, send it via vault or the secure channel. We'll hand it to the customer for baseline tests.
cto_emily: One more ask: can we get private console access from our office IPs and have session recordings enabled for audit?
infra_jordan: Yes, session recordings/onboard audit logging can be enabled. Adding to ticket requirements.
prov_bot: PROV-4857 status: in-progress. Expected ready: 2026-04-10.
se_maya: Will schedule the canary run for the day after ready state. I'll post the eval summary in the ticket.
ae_ravi: Great. Looping sales and customer success to prep contract addendum for reserved capacity if POC meets targets.
se_ash: I'll keep the customer updated. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
